title: PolicyAppliedData
description: data of policy.applied (PRD 9.5). The deterministic policy engine opened a gate under a policy (PRD 10.4). Never T3, never below L2. authz is by policy with ref equal to policy_id (EV-06), so the world draws a policy stamp and links it (HR-7). item pins the draft or file the engine assessed to its version (null when there is none); the outbox entry's item equals it (OB-05), so a redraft is a new proposal.
